# Assumption of Moses Chapter 10 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Cosmic Theophany and Final Victory

---

**1** And then his kingdom will be revealed throughout all his creation, and then the devil will come to an end, and sorrow will be removed with him.

**2** Then the messenger, who has been appointed to the highest place from the beginning, will be filled.

**3** He will arise from his place at once and avenge them against their enemies.

**4** For the Most High God, the Eternal One alone, will arise, and he will appear to punish the nations and to destroy all their idols.

**5** Then, O Israel, you will be happy, and you will mount upon the neck and wings of the eagle.

**6** And those will be ended, and God will exalt you.

**7** And you will look down from on high and will see your enemies on the ground, and you will recognize them and rejoice.

**8** And you will give thanks and confess your Creator.

**9** And you, Joshua son of Nun, keep these words and this book.

**10** For from my death and burial until his coming there will be two hundred and fifty times.

**11** This is the course of the times that will pass until they are fulfilled.

**12** I am going to my rest and my sleep with my fathers.

**13** But the Lord will comfort those who mourn and will render justice to those who are afflicted.

**14** He will bring light to those who are in darkness, and he will deliver the poor from the hand of the enemy.

**15** And in those days there will arise those who call upon his name, and they will mourn and fast and pray.

**16** And he will hear them and will deliver them from their oppression.

**17** For the Lord of lords is God of gods, a great King, and he is the God of all creation.

**18** Blessed be the Lord God, the Lord and God of all ages.
